slot_scores.name: mandatory_machine_rental_window
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does the machine need to be rented continuously from the start of activity A to the end of activity B, or can it be rented only during the specific days when activities actually require it?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the machine rental is continuous from the start of A to the end of B, fully covering the hidden slot's key meaning.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot, H1 (P1), was resolved before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL; no unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that fully recovered the hidden machine rental window and related scheduling assumptions before stopping, resulting in an appropriate READY_TO_MODEL state.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
